::: {#exm-temperature}

#### Drawing at three temperatures

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
temperatures = [0.5, 1.0, 1.5]
draws = {t: sample(lm, "MENENIUS:\n", 1000, temperature=t) for t in temperatures}
shares = [real_word_share(draws[t]) for t in temperatures]
print(shares)
# The prose below says the share falls as the temperature rises.
assert shares[0] > shares[1] > shares[2]
print(draws[0.5][:200])
print(draws[1.5][:200])
```

| [Temperature](#def-temperature) | Share of words found in the training text |
|--:|--:|
| 0.5 | `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * py$shares[[1]])` |
| 1.0 | `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * py$shares[[2]])` |
| 1.5 | `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * py$shares[[3]])` |

At temperature 0.5 the network mostly writes words it has seen.
At 1.5 most of its words are new,
and the spelling breaks down.

:::
